evidence.valueText: Fees: Gross fees charged on NEAR Intents swaps - the protocol fee plus the affiliate (distribution) fee each frontend collects, summed across all integrators. | Revenue: NEAR's net captured revenue, measured as NEAR/wNEAR swept into its revenue wallets (reconciles with revenue.near.org and the on-chain buyback). Split by destination wallet into front-end affiliate revenue and Other. Transfers between those wallets are excluded. | SupplySideRevenue: Gross fees minus NEAR's captured revenue - the affiliate fees kept by solvers and third-party distribution channels (e.g. SwapKit). | HoldersRevenue: Since 2026-02-23, NEAR's captured Intents revenue is used to buy back $NEAR on the open market (not burned), returning value to holders.

evidence.methodology: Adapter methodology text published by DefiLlama, stored verbatim after sanitization. Treated as a third-party claim.

evidence.transform: V x f x c x b
evidence.label: Annual buyback demand at current run rate
evidence.methodology: Measured run rate times measured fee, capture and buyback shares. Holds all four constant.

evidence.transform: (V x f x c x b) / M
evidence.label: Annual buyback demand / market cap
evidence.methodology: Buyback demand relative to market cap. A buyback is not a burn and does not mechanically raise price by this amount.

evidence.transform: (y x M) / (f x c x b), y = 0.02 (assumed)
evidence.label: Annual volume needed for buybacks = 2% of market cap
evidence.methodology: Volume at which buyback demand would equal a hypothetical 2% of market cap per year, with fee, capture and buyback shares at measured values.

evidence.label: Volume multiple needed for 2% of market cap
evidence.methodology: How many times today's run rate the volume would need to be.

evidence.label: Required f x c x b at today's volume for 2% of market cap
evidence.methodology: Reverse calculation: the share of every dollar of volume that would have to become buybacks. Compare with MODEL-CURRENT-TAKE-RATE.

evidence.label: Current f x c x b (volume converted to buyback demand)
evidence.methodology: Measured share of each volume dollar that becomes buyback demand.

Monthly social.near from exact data: the month two months after the launch month divided by the launch month (or the first exact month, if exact data starts within one month of launch). Adoption followed if at least 2x. A launch month that starts mid-month makes the test easier to pass, not harder. N/A when the launch months are only available as estimates.

evidence.methodology: Annualized net new tokens valued at the current price.

evidence.label: Annual Intents volume at which buyback-designated revenue equals the value of realized net new supply
evidence.methodology: Supply parity in dollars, not tokens: bought-back NEAR is held, not burned, so even at this volume total supply keeps growing. Assumes the current fee rate, capture and buyback share.

evidence.label: Parity volume as a multiple of today's Intents volume run rate
evidence.methodology: How far today's volume is from dollar parity with realized net new supply.

evidence.label: Buyback-designated Intents revenue since DefiLlama began classifying it (2026-02-23)
evidence.methodology: Sum of DefiLlama dailyHoldersRevenue for NEAR Intents from its first non-zero day. This is revenue designated for buybacks by DefiLlama's classification, not verified executed purchases.

evidence.label: Buyback wallet holdings at today's price vs cumulative buyback-designated revenue
evidence.methodology: Onchain cross-check of executed buybacks. The wallet balance (buybacks.multisignature.near) is what has actually been bought and is still held. Valued at today's price, not purchase prices, and it can include transfers, so it is a sanity check, not a reconciliation of individual trades.

evidence.label: Buyback-designated revenue as a share of realized net new supply
evidence.methodology: Annualized Intents buybacks divided by the dollar value of annualized net new supply. Paying the token if at least 50%; not paying below 25%. Buybacks are held, not burned.

evidence.label: Burns plus buybacks as a share of maximum issuance
evidence.methodology: Upper-bound denominator (protocol maximum inflation), so this understates coverage. Shown next to the realized measure for comparison.

evidence.label: All DEX volume, last 365 days (DefiLlama)
evidence.methodology: Sum of DefiLlama's total DEX volume over the last 365 complete days. Includes some prediction-market venues DefiLlama lists as DEXs.

evidence.methodology: NEAR Intents volume over the same 365 days divided by all DEX volume.

evidence.label: NEAR Intents volume, latest 30 days vs the same 30 days a year earlier
evidence.methodology: Momentum today. It is observed; it is not assumed to continue.

evidence.label: All DEX volume, compound annual growth 2021 to 2025
evidence.methodology: Calendar-year DEX volume, 2025 versus 2021, annualized over four years.

b.note: DefiLlama classification, not a guaranteed policy

y.note: Hypothetical 2% of market cap per year

scenarios.label: Conservative
scenarios.rationale: Fees compress by half as competitors undercut, NEAR keeps 25% less of fees, half of captured revenue goes to buybacks, and volume does not grow.

scenarios.label: Base
scenarios.rationale: Measured fee rate, capture and buyback share held constant, and the trailing 90-day volume run rate held flat.

b.note: DefiLlama classification, not a guaranteed policy

scenarios.label: Optimistic
scenarios.rationale: Measured fee rate and capture held, all captured revenue goes to buybacks, and volume doubles.

triggers.statement: Intents volume grows but NEAR-captured revenue per dollar of volume falls.
triggers.implication: Activity is not converting into token-level value at a stable rate.

triggers.statement: Fee compression: the effective fee rate drops by a quarter or more between consecutive 90-day windows.
triggers.implication: Competition is pricing intents settlement toward zero faster than volume grows.

triggers.statement: The volume needed for buyback revenue worth 2% of market cap is more than ten times today's run rate.
triggers.implication: Buybacks cannot be material to valuation on any plausible near-term growth path.

triggers.statement: Base-layer user activity contracts sharply year over year.
triggers.implication: Direct chain usage is shrinking; the thesis must rest on cross-chain activity rather than NEAR-native users. Accounts are not people, so this may partly reflect less automation.

triggers.statement: DeFi deposits on NEAR halve year over year.
triggers.implication: Liquidity is leaving as incentives fade; DeFi activity is not self-sustaining.

triggers.statement: Token-level value capture is under 1% of market cap per year.
triggers.implication: Burns plus buybacks are too small to be a primary valuation support today; the investment case depends on growth not yet measured.

eras.note: SocialDB contract behind NEAR Social and BOS components. Newer near.social storage paths are not included.
Chain Signatures MPC contract (created 2024-07-31, mainnet 2024-08-08). Counts include MPC node response transactions, not only user sign requests.

NEAR Intents swap volume from DefiLlama, whose coverage starts on 2024-12-10, a month after the beta launch. Volume is used instead of intents.near transaction counts, which mix relayer and solver batching with use and are NearBlocks estimates before April 2026.

events.label: Blockchain Operating System (BOS)
events.note: NEAR's 2023 review says BOS launched in February 2023 and debuted at ETHDenver. Month-level date; event window anchored on 2023-03-01.
events.productLaunchShown: February 2023 (BOS live; SocialDB already on mainnet)

events.label: Chain Signatures
events.note: Announced at BUIDL Asia, Seoul, and launched on testnet. The mainnet release followed on 8 August 2024.

events.label: User-Owned AI
events.note: NEAR positions itself as the home for User-Owned AI. No single onchain product contract represents this era, so adoption is not measured (N/A) rather than counted as a failure.

events.label: NEAR Intents (beta)
events.note: Beta launch on near.org/intents; full launch announced for Q1 2025.

sections.title: Did it last?
sections.reason: 1 of 2 era products keep at least 25% of their peak monthly activity.

sections.title: Did adoption justify the hype?
sections.reason: Product adoption followed 1 of 2 measurable pivots within two months of mainnet launch. Not measurable, so not counted: Chain Signatures, User-Owned AI.

sections.title: Does it pay $NEAR?
sections.reason: Buyback-designated Intents revenue equals 17.6% of the value of realized net new supply; the take rate is rising.

thesis.verdictReason: Sections 1 and 3 decide the verdict; Section 2 sets confidence. 1 of 2 era products keep at least 25% of their peak monthly activity. Buyback-designated Intents revenue equals 17.6% of the value of realized net new supply; the take rate is rising. Product adoption followed 1 of 2 measurable pivots within two months of mainnet launch. Not measurable, so not counted: Chain Signatures, User-Owned AI.

ladder.headline: At today's valuation premium, $25 in ten years needs NEAR Intents to win up to 5x today's share of DEX volume; $100 needs 9.1% of all DEX volume (9.0x today's share). If NEAR is priced like a cash-flow token instead, $100 needs 22.2%. How fast Intents grows moves the answer more than how the market values NEAR.
